title: Idea generation during emotion regulation: A proposed framework.
title_zh: 情绪调节中的创意生成：一套新框架
abstract: The field of emotion regulation (ER) is increasingly recognizing the influence of context on an individual's regulatory processes, prompting researchers to examine how specific circumstances dynamically shape ER. Well-accepted theoretical models and supporting empirical studies frame such situation-specific ER as a sequence of stages involving decision points: choosing to regulate, selecting a strategy, deciding whether to maintain current regulatory efforts, and so forth. These frameworks, however, omit an underappreciated process that we argue underscores ER at its highest specificity: idea generation. In other words, individuals do not just select properties of their regulatory attempt, but must actually generate an attempt-a distinction that leverages an underexplored level of analysis in ER known as techniques. In this article, we integrate multiple theoretical perspectives across domains to demonstrate the feasibility in (and insight afforded by) measuring idea generation in ER. Next, we review how existing empirical paradigms already utilize generation-related principles in largely unacknowledged manners, with some studies that have specifically targeted these generative operations during ER. We combine these observations into a novel framework called Emotion Regulation Generation of Techniques, which serves to deepen the study of ER by delineating a generation stage that follows and informs selection mechanisms. To help study idea generation in practice, this framework is equipped with methodological protocols that draw from neighboring domains (e.g., divergent thinking), paired with future directions and testable hypotheses that can inform the role of idea generation in healthy regulation and in dysregulated affective disorders. abstract_zh: 情绪调节（ER）领域正日益认识到情境对个体调节过程的影响，促使研究者探讨特定情境如何动态塑造ER。公认的理论模型和支持性实证研究将情境特定的ER描述为一系列阶段，包括决策点：选择调节、选择策略、决定是否维持当前调节努力等。然而，这些框架忽略了一个被低估的过程，我们认为它是ER最高特异性的核心：创意生成。换言之，个体不仅选择调节尝试的属性，还必须实际生成一次尝试——这一区别利用了ER中一个尚未充分探索的分析层面，即技术。在本文中，我们整合跨领域的多种理论视角，展示在ER中测量创意生成的可行性及其所带来的洞见。随后，我们回顾现有实证范式如何在很大程度上以未被充分承认的方式利用生成相关原则，并指出一些专门针对ER期间生成操作的研究。我们将这些观察整合为一个新框架，称为情绪调节技术生成（Emotion Regulation Generation of Techniques），该框架通过划分一个生成阶段来深化对ER的研究，该阶段既跟随又指导选择机制。为帮助实践中研究创意生成，该框架配备了借鉴邻近领域（如发散性思维）的方法学协议，并提出未来方向和可检验的假设，以阐明创意生成在健康调节和失调情绪障碍中的作用。（PsycInfo 数据库记录（c）2026 APA，保留所有权利）
